Author: KeydenK
Name: Giddy Up
Punchline: Mounting, dismounting and Sprint done for you, at the right moment.
Description: Giddy Up handles your mount and your running speed so you don't have to: it mounts you up when you start moving after a zone change, a fight or gathering; gets you off the mount when you use an action or when the enemy you targeted comes into your attack range; uses Sprint when it helps and keeps Peloton up on jobs that have it. Everything is timed from your own measured speeds. Works great with Beeline. Command: /giddyup
